Margaritaville at Sea Black Friday Early Access: 3rd and 4th guests sail free

65% off cruise fares and a USD 0 fare for the 3rd and 4th guests in a stateroom on select sailings, but taxes, fees and port expenses still apply to every guest and the page states no child age terms or sailing dates.

Book by November 3, 2026.

facebook.text:
Margaritaville at Sea Black Friday Early Access: 3rd and 4th guests sail free

65% off cruise fares and a USD 0 fare for the 3rd and 4th guests in a stateroom on select sailings, but taxes, fees and port expenses still apply to every guest and the page states no child age terms or sailing dates.

For two adults and two children in one stateroom, the page says the 3rd and 4th guests pay a USD 0 cruise fare when at least two paying guests share the stateroom, on select sailing dates that can change without notice. Taxes, fees and port expenses are still charged for all four guests, and onboard charges are not included. The 65% off applies to cruise fares for guests in the reservation party; the page says offers combine unless otherwise stated, but it does not show how the 65% and the free 3rd and 4th guest fares work together on one booking. A reduced USD 50 per person deposit is offered on select sailings, with the balance due on the sailing's final payment date.

Book by November 3, 2026.

Checked on the official page October 28: Margaritaville at Sea Black Friday Early Access page.

facebook.text:
ZooLights at Lincoln Park Zoo: four free Monday nights with a reservation

When: Friday, November 20, 2026 to Sunday, January 3, 2027, 4:30 to 9 p.m.; last entry 8 p.m. No ZooLights on Thanksgiving (November 26), Tuesdays December 1, 8 and 15, or December 24 and 25.

Cost: Fixed-date tickets USD 7 to USD 12 per person bought in advance, by date; USD 20 bought on the day or for a flexible ticket. Free on Mondays November 23 and 30 and December 7 and 14 with a reservation.

Booking: Everyone needs a ticket, including children and infants. Free Monday tickets are released one week ahead at 11 a.m. CT.

Family note: Because infants need a ticket too, count every child when booking a free Monday.

threads.text:
Bronx Zoo Holiday Lights: Children's Zoo Farmyard opens for the lights, new for 2026

When: Select dates from November 21, 2026 to January 3, 2027. Check the zoo's tickets page for available dates and times.

Cost: Admission price not shown on the event page; see the tickets page. The Holiday Train is USD 4 (USD 3 for members).

New for 2026: the Children's Zoo Farmyard opens during Holiday Lights, and a 2-in-1 ticket lets you arrive at 1 p.m. to see animals before the lights.
